title: Whistle! - Dai-37-kai Tokyo-to Chuugakkou Sougou Taiiku Soccer Taikai (Japan)

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'WHISTLE\0' save signature written by FUN_080380e4, verified by FUN_080380a8

fields.name: save_signature_whistle
fields.description: 8-byte save signature, ASCII 'WHISTLE' plus NUL terminator. Written by FUN_080380e4 from the ROM constant at _DAT_08038148 and byte-compared on load by FUN_080380a8 via func_0x0803a958 against _DAT_080380d4.
fields.evidence: FUN_080380e4 copies 8 bytes (*puVar4/_DAT_08038148) to struct+0x0; FUN_080380a8 validates via func_0x0803a958 vs _DAT_080380d4; baseline bytes 57 48 49 53 54 4C 45 00.

fields.name: payload_status_word
fields.description: First payload word after the header checksum. The save-init routine FUN_080380e4 explicitly clears struct offset +0xC to zero before recomputing checksums and writing SRAM; zero on a fresh save.
fields.evidence: FUN_080380e4 writes *(undefined4 *)(iVar3 + 0xc) = 0 (save-file offset 0xC); persisted by func_0x0803a590 to SRAM 0x0E000000 and reloaded by FUN_080380a8 via func_0x0803a458.

fields.name: gameplay_progress_flags
fields.description: Gameplay progress / unlock bitfield at the head of the save payload region. SRAM mirror (FUN_080380a8 / FUN_080380e4 / FUN_080381a8) persists bytes [0xC, 0x8B0) verbatim; this word is the first generic progress slot after the status word. All bits zero on the fresh baseline save.
fields.evidence: Inside SRAM-mirrored payload [0xC, 0x8B0) managed by FUN_080380a8 (load), FUN_080380e4 (store) and FUN_080381a8 (validate); adjacent to confirmed anchors at struct+0xC (FUN_080380e4) and struct+0x8B0 (FUN_080381a8).

fields.name: config_options_word
fields.description: Configuration / options word (sound, difficulty, display settings class of value) in the save payload head. Preserved verbatim by the SRAM mirror routines; zero on the fresh baseline save.
fields.evidence: Inside SRAM-mirrored payload [0xC, 0x8B0) managed by FUN_080380a8 (load via func_0x0803a458, 0x8000 bytes from 0x0E000000), FUN_080380e4 (store via func_0x0803a590) and FUN_080381a8 (validate).

fields.name: payload_data_reserved
fields.description: Remainder of the checksummed save payload (up to the trailer checksum). Opaque in this decomp slice: all RAM addresses are DAT-global driven and gameplay accessors dispatch through unrecovered jumptables, so no per-field gameplay accessors are visible. Zero on the fresh baseline save.
fields.evidence: Covered by the FUN_080381fc byte-sum (validated by FUN_080381a8) over the payload up to struct+0x8B0; mirrored to SRAM 0x0E000000 by FUN_080380e4 via func_0x0803a590.

fields.name: checksum_trailer_custom
fields.description: Trailer checksum word computed by FUN_08038224 with a custom address-weighted accumulation (decompiles as sum of (cursor + *cursor) bytes, i.e. ROM/RAM-address dependent, not expressible in Schema v2 algorithms). Validated by FUN_080381a8 and stored by FUN_080380e4. Value 0xC7FFC242 on baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08038224 accumulates over _DAT_08038244 for _DAT_08038248+1 bytes into struct+0x8B0; FUN_080381a8 zeroes struct+0x8B0, recomputes via func_0x08038224 and compares; FUN_080380e4 stores via func_0x0803a590.
